items.title: Spaghettifying DRAM
items.title_zh: “Spaghettifying DRAM”：新攻击技术扩大硬件攻击面
items.title_en: Spaghettifying DRAM: New Attack Expands Hardware Attack Surface
items.summary: A new DRAM manipulation technique that expands the hardware attack surface and enables deep system compromise, as demonstrated by Christopher Domas.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (on OpenRouter)
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 发布：API上线、开放权重，参数达1.7万亿
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Released via API and Open Weights on Hugging Face
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 has been released via API with open weights on Hugging Face, featuring 1.7T parameters.

items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.title_zh: 谷歌推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，新一代高效 AI 模型
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, a Speedy New AI Model
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new efficient AI model with competitive vision-to-HTML performance and notable pricing changes, sparking active community debate.

items.title: Choose Boring Technology (2015)
items.title_zh: 选择无聊的技术：为「创新代币」辩护的经典观点
items.title_en: Choose Boring Technology: The Enduring Case for Innovation Tokens
items.summary: Argues that companies should prefer boring, proven technology for most problems, conserving limited 'innovation tokens' for areas where they truly matter.

items.title: DeepSeek Harness developer preview
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 MIT 许可的 DeepSeek Harness 开发者预览版
items.title_en: DeepSeek Releases MIT-Licensed DeepSeek Harness Developer Preview
items.summary: DeepSeek releases an MIT-licensed developer preview of DeepSeek Harness, an agent orchestration framework emphasizing full traceability, hot-reload, and dynamic plugin capabilities.

items.title: DeepMind 推手语转文字模型 SL2T，首次落地 Pixel 11 键盘与实时字幕
items.title_zh: DeepMind 发布 SL2T 手语转文字模型，首次落地 Pixel 11
items.title_en: DeepMind's SL2T Brings Sign-Language-to-Text AI to Pixel 11
items.summary: Google DeepMind's new sign language-to-text model SL2T is first deployed on Pixel 11's Gboard and Live Transcribe, supporting ASL-to-English with 100k hours of multilingual training data.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek Harness 已发布，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 权重已开放
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布开源 Harness，并开放 V4-Pro-0813 权重
items.title_en: DeepSeek Releases Open-Source Harness and V4-Pro-0813 Weights
items.summary: DeepSeek released the open-source 'Harness' application and made DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 weights available on Hugging Face.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 升级 ChatGPT GPT-5.6 系列并开放更多免费权限  OpenAI 宣布更新 ChatGPT 模型体验。
items.title_zh: OpenAI升级ChatGPT GPT-5.6系列并扩大免费访问
items.title_en: OpenAI Upgrades ChatGPT with GPT-5.6 Series and Expands Free Access
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-5.6 series upgrades, including improved paid-tier models and free-tier access with a new Think button for complex reasoning.

items.title: 🤖 Google 发布 Gemini 3.6 Flash，并透露 Gemini 4 已启动预训练  Google 发布 Gemini 3.6 Flash，称新模
items.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.6 Flash，并透露 Gemini 4 已开始预训练
items.title_en: Google Releases Gemini 3.6 Flash, Reveals Gemini 4 Pretraining Has Begun
items.summary: Google announces Gemini 3.6 Flash with token efficiency and capability improvements, while revealing Gemini 4 has started pretraining.
